name: file-check
description: AWS Lambda: checks that each uploaded file's content matches its declared type, then reports to the API.

scripts.build: esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f function.zip && zip -q function.zip index.mjs
